differences.what: The picker is the section Focused exam of the General note type, right after Vitals and before Assessment; general-1 gives the note type's header.
Prompt: What did you examine? is the label of one choose-many field, exam.systems, with an option for each system, in the order of the lines.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory construct 42

differences.what: Each option's label is the picker's short name and its code the system's id (focused-exam inventory section 2): general_appearance (General), heent, cardiovascular (Cardiac), pulmonary, abdominal (Abdomen), msk, neurologic (Neuro), skin, peripheral_vascular, diabetic_foot (Foot), gu, psych_observation (Psych), lymphatic (Lymph), neck_thyroid (Neck / Thyroid), breast, rectal. Every exam module's sections show while their system's code is picked.
GU, Breast and Rectal carry sensitiveExam: the picker's answer drops those codes for a reader without the key and from the recap for everyone, and only a sensitive exam section may test them.
Other is kept, with no module: it asks for a short text, which is the free-text exam.

After the picker come the 21 exam modules, one include each, in the order of the focused-exam inventory's section 7 (version 1 of exam_general_appearance, exam_heent_eyes, exam_heent_ears, exam_heent_nose, exam_heent_mouth, exam_cv_rhythm, exam_cv_perfusion, exam_pulmonary, exam_abdominal, exam_msk, exam_neuro_1, exam_neuro_2, exam_skin, exam_gu, exam_lymphatic, exam_peripheral_vascular, exam_breast, exam_rectal, exam_psychiatric, exam_foot, exam_neck). An include has no showWhen of its own: each section of a module already shows only while its system is picked, and the resolver would join a second, equal condition to each.
The example selection is not typed: Cardiovascular is the review step's name for Cardiac.
+ ADD EXAM is the picker itself, opened again; it stores nothing.
Only the selected sections expand: each module section's showWhen.
CONTINUE is the screen's flow, not a field.
